zh: 我刚把新打印机设置好了。
old_en: I just set up the new printer.
new_en: I just set up the new printer.

zh: 电脑死机了，我重新设置了一下网络。
old_en: The computer kept crashing, so I set up a new system.
new_en: The computer crashed, so I reset the network.

zh: 我刚把会议室的投影仪设置好了。
old_en: I just set up the projector in the meeting room.
new_en: I just set up the projector in the meeting room.

zh: 请你帮我把会议室的投影仪设置一下。
old_en: Could you please help me set up the projector in the meeting room?
new_en: Could you help me set up the projector in the meeting room?

zh: 我刚把新书架安装好了。
old_en: I just set up the new bookshelf.
new_en: I just installed the new bookshelf.

zh: 你能帮我把书架安装好吗？
old_en: Could you help me set up the bookshelf, please?
new_en: Could you help me install the bookshelf, please?

zh: 电脑出了故障，我赶紧把自动备份设置好。
old_en: The computer broke down, so I quickly set up an automatic backup.
new_en: The computer broke down, so I quickly set up an automatic backup.

zh: 这次视频会议总是断线，我决定重新设置一下网络。
old_en: I decided to set up the equipment again because this video conference kept dropping.
new_en: The video meeting keeps disconnecting, so I decided to reset the network.

zh: 请帮我把新打印机设置一下。
old_en: Can you set up the new printer for me, please?
new_en: Can you set up the new printer for me, please?

zh: 我刚把新手机设置好了。
old_en: I just set up the new phone.
new_en: I just set up the new phone.

zh: 你能帮我把新手机设置一下吗？
old_en: Could you help set up the new phone for me?
new_en: Can you help me set up the new phone?

zh: 生日聚会前，我们把客厅布置好了。
old_en: Before the birthday party, we set up the living room.
new_en: Before the birthday party, we set up the living room.

zh: 你能帮我布置一下生日聚会吗？
old_en: Could you set up the party decorations for my birthday celebration?
new_en: Can you help me set up the birthday party?

zh: 他的电脑老死机，我帮他重新装好了系统。
old_en: He had frequent computer crashes, so I set up a new system for him.
new_en: His computer kept crashing, so I reinstalled the system for him.

zh: 电梯出故障了，维修工赶紧装好了新零件。
old_en: The elevator broke down, so the repairman set up the new parts quickly.
new_en: The elevator broke down, so the repairman quickly installed new parts.

zh: 为了防止电梯出故障，物业装好了应急设备。
old_en: To prevent the elevator from malfunctioning, the management set up emergency equipment.
new_en: To prevent elevator problems, the management installed emergency equipment.

zh: 车在半路抛锚了，我赶紧换上了备用轮胎。
old_en: The car broke down halfway, so I set up the spare tire.
new_en: The car broke down halfway, so I put on the spare tire.

zh: 昨天车抛锚了，他只好把车送去修。
old_en: His car broke down yesterday, so he had to set it up for repair.
new_en: His car broke down yesterday, so he had to take it to the mechanic.

zh: 网站打不开了，我赶紧把手机设置成热点。
old_en: I quickly set up my phone as a hotspot when the website wouldn't load.
new_en: The website wouldn't load, so I quickly turned my phone into a hotspot.

zh: 为了这次视频会议，我得提前把设备设置好。
old_en: I had to set up the equipment before the video conference.
new_en: I need to set up the equipment before the video meeting.
